SELECT
  subq_3.metric_time__quarter AS metric_time__quarter
  , subq_3.bank__ticker AS bank__ticker
  , SUM(subq_3.__total_deposits) AS total_deposits
FROM (
  SELECT
    total_deposits AS __total_deposits
    , bank__ticker
    , quarter_id__quarter
    , metric_time__quarter
    , bank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('quarter', (case month(quarter_id)
        when 3 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 1, 1)
        when 6 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 4, 1)
        when 9 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 7, 1)
        when 12 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 10, 1)
        else null
      end)) AS quarter_id__quarter
      , DATE_TRUNC('quarter', (case month(quarter_id)
        when 3 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 1, 1)
        when 6 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 4, 1)
        when 9 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 7, 1)
        when 12 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 10, 1)
        else null
      end)) AS metric_time__quarter
      , bank_key AS bank
      , ticker AS bank__ticker
      , entity_level AS bank__entity_level
      , deposits_usd_thousands AS total_deposits
    FROM "ci"."main"."fct_bank_financials_quarterly" bank_financials_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE (
    bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
  ) AND (
    bank__ticker = ? AND metric_time__quarter = ? AND bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
  )
) subq_3

  SELECT
    bank
    , metric_time__quarter
    , MAX(quarter_id__quarter) AS quarter_id__quarter__complete
  FROM (

      DATE_TRUNC('quarter', (case month(quarter_id)
        when 3 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 1, 1)
        when 6 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 4, 1)
        when 9 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 7, 1)
        when 12 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 10, 1)
        else null
      end)) AS quarter_id__quarter
      , DATE_TRUNC('quarter', (case month(quarter_id)
        when 3 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 1, 1)
        when 6 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 4, 1)
        when 9 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 7, 1)
        when 12 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 10, 1)
        else null
      end)) AS metric_time__quarter
      , bank_key AS bank
      , ticker AS bank__ticker
      , entity_level AS bank__entity_level
    FROM "ci"."main"."fct_bank_financials_quarterly" bank_financials_src_10000
  ) subq_2
  WHERE (
    bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
  ) AND (
    bank__ticker = ? AND metric_time__quarter = ? AND bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
  )
  GROUP BY
    bank
    , metric_time__quarter
) subq_5
ON
  (
    subq_3.quarter_id__quarter = subq_5.quarter_id__quarter__complete
  ) AND (
    subq_3.bank = subq_5.bank
  )
GROUP BY
  subq_3.metric_time__quarter
  , subq_3.bank__ticker

  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', (case month(quarter_id)
      when 3 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 1, 1)
      when 6 then make_date(year(quarter_id), 4, 1)

    , bank_key AS bank
    , ticker AS bank__ticker

SELECT
  metric_time__quarter AS metric_time__quarter
  , bank__ticker AS bank__ticker
  , (deposits - deposits_prev) / nullif(deposits_prev, 0) AS deposits_qoq_growth
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(subq_9.metric_time__quarter, subq_23.metric_time__quarter) AS metric_time__quarter
    , COALESCE(subq_9.bank__ticker, subq_23.bank__ticker) AS bank__ticker
    , MAX(subq_9.deposits) AS deposits
    , MAX(subq_23.deposits_prev) AS deposits_prev
  FROM (
    SELECT
      subq_3.metric_time__quarter AS metric_time__quarter
      , subq_3.bank__ticker AS bank__ticker
      , SUM(subq_3.__total_deposits) AS deposits
    FROM (
      SELECT
        total_deposits AS __total_deposits
        , bank__ticker
        , quarter_id__quarter
        , metric_time__quarter
        , bank
      FROM (
        SELECT
          quarter_id__quarter
          , metric_time__quarter
          , bank
          , bank__ticker
          , bank__entity_level
          , __total_deposits AS total_deposits
        FROM sma_10001_cte
      ) subq_2
      WHERE (
        bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
      ) AND (
        bank__ticker = ? AND metric_time__quarter = ? AND bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
      )
    ) subq_3
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT
        bank
        , metric_time__quarter
        , MAX(quarter_id__quarter) AS quarter_id__quarter__complete
      FROM (
        SELECT
          quarter_id__quarter
          , metric_time__quarter
          , bank
          , bank__ticker
          , bank__entity_level
        FROM sma_10001_cte
      ) subq_2
      WHERE (
        bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
      ) AND (
        bank__ticker = ? AND metric_time__quarter = ? AND bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
      )
      GROUP BY
        bank
        , metric_time__quarter
    ) subq_5
    ON
      (
        subq_3.quarter_id__quarter = subq_5.quarter_id__quarter__complete
      ) AND (
        subq_3.bank = subq_5.bank
      )
    GROUP BY
      subq_3.metric_time__quarter
      , subq_3.bank__ticker
  ) subq_9
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
      subq_21.metric_time__quarter AS metric_time__quarter
      , subq_17.bank__ticker AS bank__ticker
      , subq_17.__total_deposits AS deposits_prev
    FROM (
      SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', date_day) AS metric_time__quarter
      FROM "ci"."main"."metricflow_time_spine" time_spine_src_10000
      GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', date_day)
    ) subq_21
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT
        subq_12.metric_time__quarter AS metric_time__quarter
        , subq_12.bank__ticker AS bank__ticker
        , SUM(subq_12.__total_deposits) AS __total_deposits
      FROM (
        SELECT

          , bank__ticker
          , quarter_id__quarter
          , metric_time__quarter
          , bank
        FROM (
          SELECT
            quarter_id__quarter
            , metric_time__quarter
            , bank
            , bank__ticker
            , bank__entity_level
            , __total_deposits AS total_deposits
          FROM sma_10001_cte
        ) subq_11
        WHERE (
          bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
        ) AND (
          bank__ticker = ? AND metric_time__quarter = ? AND bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
        )
      ) subq_12
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
          bank
          , metric_time__quarter
          , MAX(quarter_id__quarter) AS quarter_id__quarter__complete
        FROM (
          SELECT
            quarter_id__quarter
            , metric_time__quarter
            , bank
            , bank__ticker
            , bank__entity_level
          FROM sma_10001_cte
        ) subq_11
        WHERE (
          bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
        ) AND (
          bank__ticker = ? AND metric_time__quarter = ? AND bank__entity_level = 'bank_subsidiary'
        )
        GROUP BY
          bank
          , metric_time__quarter
      ) subq_14
      ON
        (
          subq_12.quarter_id__quarter = subq_14.quarter_id__quarter__complete
        ) AND (
          subq_12.bank = subq_14.bank
        )
      GROUP BY
        subq_12.metric_time__quarter
        , subq_12.bank__ticker
    ) subq_17
    ON
      subq_21.metric_time__quarter - INTERVAL 3 month = subq_17.metric_time__quarter
  ) subq_23
  ON
    (
      subq_9.bank__ticker = subq_23.bank__ticker
    ) AND (
      subq_9.metric_time__quarter = subq_23.metric_time__quarter
    )
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(subq_9.metric_time__quarter, subq_23.metric_time__quarter)
    , COALESCE(subq_9.bank__ticker, subq_23.bank__ticker)
) subq_24
